crossRefs.note: “Their feet are swift to shed blood.

people.name: Ahimelech
people.line: High Priest at Nob who helped David, killed by Saul

people.name: Ahitub
people.line: Father of Ahimelech, High Priest at Nob killed by Saul

people.name: Nob
people.line: A city of priests near Jerusalem

translations.web: Then the king sent to call Ahimelech the priest, the son of Ahitub, and all his father’s house, the priests who were in Nob; and they all came to the king.
translations.bsb: Then the king sent messengers to summon Ahimelech the priest, the son of Ahitub, and his father’s whole family, who were priests at Nob. And all of them came to the king.
translations.kjv: Then the king sent to call Ahimelech the priest, the son of Ahitub, and all his father's house, the priests that were in Nob: and they came all of them to the king.
translations.asv: Then the king sent to call Ahimelech the priest, the son of Ahitub, and all his father's house, the priests that were in Nob: and they came all of them to the king.
